readback.scope: Public release and buyer intake wording only. Verify the live capture receipt and match the live hash to an authoritative deployment receipt before assigning a cutoff. This check cannot establish requests, replies, orders or settlement.

release_and_cutoff_binding: Confirm against the authoritative deployment receipt and check for a superseding release or committed verdict before closure.
decision_if_cutoff_confirmed: End the measurement window as inconclusive. Retain the live intake under its existing terms.
reconsider_on: A release-attributed eligible inquiry or evidence resolving feedback coverage.
